fixed.summary: Loading a UI document no longer reads the whole style sheet again. A style pack's CSS over the default style (or the default style's role rules, without a pack) is tokenized, its selectors parsed and its rule bodies lowered once, and every document shares the result; only matching the document's own elements is left. A small document's parse takes 0.46 ms instead of 2.9 ms under the default style and 8.6 ms instead of 35.6 ms under the fantasy pack (release build, Linux).
